about.name: Gabe Simanjuntak
about.bio:
Hi, I'm Gabe Simanjuntak.

 I am a Software Engineering enthusiast with a passion for building modern, user-friendly, and impactful digital solutions. I enjoy developing web and mobile applications, designing intuitive user experiences, and continuously learning new technologies. My interests include full-stack development, UI/UX design, API integration, and software testing. I believe that great software is not only functional but also meaningful for its users.
